aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but mis-scopes the changed factor and omits most report outcomes.
issues: Changed factor should reflect tin supplier change, not only Normal vs Test labels.
Only module-line function NG is captured; other validation results are omitted.
Judgement 'improved' conflicts with report decision that results are same as normal.
Outcome parsing lacks nearby headers, so NG totals/rates may be unreliable.
Review title is taken from decap sheet instead of main test report context.
correctionPlan: Define primary changed factor as CSY Tech Vina tin supplier change with Normal vs Test as comparison conditions.
Use TEST title, purpose, content, and decision rows as main review context.
Add all comparable outcomes: vision spot welding, SP+coil tension, SPK function, module function, and F-PCB+SP tension.
Cite header rows with each data pair before calculating rates or pass/fail judgements.
Treat decap sheet as supporting NG analysis unless creating a separate cited outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient; add main title, headers, all compared rows, and decision rows.
